name: open_urls
description: Fetch one or more web pages in a single call and return their full contents. Use after `web_search` to read the most promising results, or when the user gives you URL(s) directly. Pass multiple URLs in one call rather than issuing parallel `open_urls` calls — they are fetched concurrently server-side. Returns `{results: [{title, link, full_content, published_date?, scrape_successful}, ...]}` in the same order as the input.

urls.description: Absolute http(s) URLs to fetch (min 1, max 10). Pass every URL you want to read in one call — they are fetched concurrently.
